item.name: Runic Shield of Thar-Grim
item.text: A heavy dwarven shield embedded with glowing runes.

You gain a +1 bonus to AC. Once per long rest, when hit by a melee attack, you can use your reaction to force the attacker to make a DC 13 Dexterity saving throw: On a failed save, the attacker takes 2d6 fire damage and has disadvantage on their next attack roll.

item.name: Girdle of the stoneblood clan
item.text: A broad dwarven belt engraved with the runes of the Stoneblood Clan.
Your Strength score increases by 1, to a maximum of 21. While raging, you gain resistance to force damage.Once per day, if you drop below 25% HP while raging, you gain 10 temporary hit points.

item.name: Forge-Soul Focus
item.text: A focus made from obsidian fused with glowing forge veins.
You gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls. Once per day, a fire spell you cast can ignore fire resistance. You can cast Control Flames once per day

item.name: Bracers of the emberwright
item.text: Forged by ancient dwarven smith-mages, these rune-etched bracers glow faintly when channeling fire magic or tinkering with tools.

You gain a +1 bonus to spell attack rolls made using artificer spells. You gan a +1 bonus to checks made with Tinker's tools and smith tools. Once per day, when casting a spell that deals fire damage, you can reroll one damage die

item.name: Bonecrusher’s Hammer
item.detail: Weapon (maul or warhammer, uncommon, attunement by a Barbarian)
item.text: This massive hammer thrums with savage force. When swung in a berserker’s rage, it seems to resonate with the bones of those it strikes, splintering them into dust with each brutal blow. Bonecrushing Effect (2/Rage). While raging, you may unleash this devastating effect up to 2 times per rage when you hit a creature with a skeletal structure (humanoids, beasts, undead, etc.) The target must succeed on a DC 13 Strength saving throw.On a failed save, the hammer’s blow shatters bones and sends splinters flying, dealing 1d6 necrotic damage. The target is left weakened and staggering, suffering disadvantage on Strength saving throws until the start of your next turn. On a success, the target resists the crushing force, though the echo of your strike can still be felt. Creatures without bones (oozes, elementals, constructs, etc.) are unaffected, though they feel the sheer weight of your fury.
